speaker: Doctor
text: I need to start by understanding the nature of your symptoms. Can you describe the characteristics of your abdominal pain and tell me if the weight loss has been unintentional?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That weight loss combined with night sweats is concerning; has this abdominal pain radiated anywhere, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool color? Also, could you clarify if the lymph node enlargement is new or if you have noticed other swollen areas?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: That rapid onset of a fixed, non-tender supraclavicular node alongside B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) is highly alarming. Could you describe the texture of the abdominal mass, is it tender, and have you experienced any fever or loss of appetite? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, ESR, LDH. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_CT_with_contrast.
